hintContracts.Activate: 0x576860 active same pointer is no-op. Null target clears only active pointer. Unless force-display, done flag blocks unless ignore-done and timer must be<=0 or quiet NaN. Acceptance resets presentation dwords9514c8/cc topositivezero, sets active pointer, optionally marks completion14/bitmap when target flags2bit1 and not force-display. Draws original QRAND repeatedly until draw/16384 differs from previous variant byte9514bd, writes variant, and copies cooldown0xc float32 to timer0x18.
hintContracts.MarkDone: 0x5766e0 scans first signed-ID match in0x1c-stride list until-1; bitmap uses ordinal>>5, lower5bits shift, and signed declared word-count bound. Matching by ID rather than record identity preserves duplicate-ID behavior.
